context_for_next_testing_agent: When Playwright clicks on /staff/mobile fail mysteriously (e.g. staff-attachment-checkin-btn not opening sheet), use page.evaluate(el => el.click()) to bypass the Emergent chat-widget iframe overlay. The widget sits above many staff UI elements at viewport 414x896. Also hide it BEFORE login with add_init_script + MutationObserver because it is injected after page load. PIN-login flow: staff-mobile-pin-toggle → staff-mobile-pin-input → staff-mobile-pin-login-btn.
rca of the issue: iter85 FIX-2 root cause was correctly identified by main agent as inline-function instability — fix (openAttachmentSheet stable arrow at StaffMobilePage.jsx:151) IS working. The remaining 1500ms-timeout 'failure' in this iteration is NOT a functional bug — it is the Emergent chat-widget iframe (z-index ~9999) overlapping the bottom area of the 414-wide viewport and absorbing the click event. Verified by re-firing the click via element.click() in page.evaluate which bypassed the overlay and opened the sheet within ~100ms. Mitigation: hide the chat-widget on /staff/mobile route OR push staff UI z-index above the widget. Same observation was noted in iter85 design_issues.
